description: REGRESSION (double rounding): Nebraska's use tax has TWO whole-dollar boxes and the booklet says 'round your results, and then add them together'. 1.5% of $33 is 0.495 -> $0 local, plus 5.5% x 33 = 1.815 -> $2 state = $2. A cent-then-dollar chain rounded the local line to $1 and returned $3.
